title: 第17章 这父子两都踏马是妖孽第18章 帝都 许家
content_zh:
李宝已经傻了！
今天有属实有点太热闹了！
四大家族掌舵人，万宝阁阁主到场也就罢了！
怎么他那亲爱的父皇，大虞的皇帝陛下，也跑过来凑热闹？
就在众人愣神间，龙辇已经稳稳停在地上。
“见过陛下！”
“见过父皇！”
众人齐刷刷行礼！
在这位皇帝陛下面前，即便是高傲如杨无敌，也不得不弯腰。
在场，只有两个人没有动。
一个是万宝阁主常天水。
他无需行礼，即便是皇帝，也没有资格让他行礼！
因为他背后站着万宝阁！
大虞万宝阁，其实不过是总阁的分支。
而万宝阁总阁，即便在中土大陆，都是一方巨无霸！
所以他有底气！
另一个便是许渊。
他本人对皇权确实不感冒。
当然，也不用指望一个身怀屠龙术的人，对皇权有什么敬畏之心。
许渊目光直视，打量着龙辇。

透过纱帐，能隐约间看见一道身影正慵懒的躺在软榻上。
身边还有几道倩影，捶肩按腿投喂水果，各司其职。
他不由咂咂嘴。
真是万恶的封建社会！
这时，一阵爽朗的大笑响起，接着龙辇上的纱帐从两边打开。
就见一位眼神慵懒，穿着亵衣亵裤的中年人，走了出来。
中年并没有皇帝该有的威严，反而显得有些浪荡轻浮。
怎么看都不像是帝王。
反而更像一个人到中年，依旧一事无成，只知享乐的纨绔子弟。
他也没有皇帝架子，也并不责怪许渊没有恭顺之心。
反而看了一眼众人后，挥了挥衣袍，笑着说：
“今天这么热闹，行了也不用如此多礼，都起来。”
“多谢陛下！”
众人道谢之后，才直起腰。
此时每个人的眼神，都有些疑惑
不明白皇帝过来是要干嘛。
说实话，这位绝对是大虞史上最奇葩的皇帝。
content_en:
Li Bao is already stupid!
Today is really a bit too lively!
The leaders of the four major families and the master of Wanbao Pavilion are just here!
Why did his dear father, His Majesty the Emperor of Dayu, come over to join in the fun?
While everyone was stunned, the dragon chariot had stopped firmly on the ground.
"I have met His Majesty!"
"I've met my father!"
Everyone saluted in unison!
In front of His Majesty the Emperor, even as arrogant as Yang Wudi had to bend down.
There were only two people present who did not move.
One is Chang Tianshui, the master of Wanbao Pavilion.
He does not need to salute, even the emperor is not qualified to ask him to salute!
Because behind him stands Wanbao Pavilion!
Dayu Wanbao Pavilion is actually just a branch of the main pavilion.
And the Main Pavilion of Wanbao Pavilion is a giant even in Middle-earth!
So he is confident!
The other one is Xu Yuan.
He himself is really not interested in imperial power.
Of course, there is no need to expect a person with dragon-slaying skills to have any respect for the imperial power.
Xu Yuan looked directly at the dragon chariot.
Through the gauze curtain, one could vaguely see a figure lying lazily on the soft couch.
There are several beautiful figures around, beating their shoulders and legs, feeding them fruits, each performing their own duties.
He couldn't help but smack his lips.
What an evil feudal society!
At this time, a burst of hearty laughter sounded, and then the gauze curtains on the dragon chariot were opened from both sides.
Then I saw a middle-aged man with lazy eyes, wearing obscene clothes and pants, walking out.
The middle-aged man does not have the majesty that an emperor should have, but instead seems a bit dissolute and frivolous.
He doesn't look like an emperor in any way.
On the contrary, he is more like a playboy who has achieved nothing in middle age and only knows how to have fun.
He didn't have the airs of an emperor, and he didn't blame Xu Yuan for not being submissive.
Instead, after taking a look at everyone, he waved his robe and said with a smile:
"It's so lively today, so there's no need to be so polite, just get up."
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
After everyone thanked him, they straightened up.
At this time, everyone's eyes were a little confused.
I don’t understand what the emperor is doing here.
To be honest, this is definitely the most bizarre emperor in the history of Yu.
